description: The Advanced Technology Microwave Sounder (ATMS) on Suomi NPP, a 22-channel cross-track microwave sounder (23.8-183.3 GHz). The curves are the 196 measured channel spectral response functions of the public-release dataset for each tested receiver temperature, LO bias and LO unit, converted from frequency to wavelength.
facility_description: The Joint Polar Satellite System (JPSS) is NOAA's polar-orbiting series (Suomi NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21, ...).

notes: Wavelengths in Angstrom are c/nu of the owner's RF frequencies (Hz); response 10**(dBm/10) scaled to peak 1. The operational configuration since November 8 2011 is 'Primary LO, nominal LO bias' (README), i.e. the ch<nn>_Pri_VN_* files. For channels 3-22 each file covers the RF range as tabulated (README: consider 'the receiver sideband configuration'). SVO's archived ATMS-NPP records have pivots 10 times larger than c/nu of these channels (e.g. ch01 1.26e9 A for 23.8 GHz); the NJM curves use the correct conversion. DetectorType energy is assumed.
